upstream.description: Extract any sound with text prompts. Memory-optimized SAM-Audio with modern UI.

classification.analysis: AudioGhost AI is a full-stack web app for text-prompted audio source separation: users describe a sound in natural language (e.g. "vocals", "a dog barking") and the app extracts or removes it from an uploaded audio or video file. It wraps Meta's SAM-Audio model in a memory-optimized "lite mode" that cuts VRAM usage up to 40%, with a Next.js/Tailwind frontend, FastAPI backend, and Celery/Redis task queue for async processing. Aimed at hobbyists and audio engineers with a CUDA GPU who want local, prompt-driven stem separation without a full 12GB+ VRAM requirement.

use_cases.title: Extract vocals or specific sounds from an audio file using a text prompt
Remove background noise or a specific sound source from a video's audio track
Run SAM-Audio inference locally on a consumer GPU with reduced VRAM footprint
